name: Super Star Party
longDescription: Super Star Party is a free party board game for up to 4 players that runs right in your browser. Built with AI, with nothing to install: open it and play.
about: Super Star Party is a free party board game for 1 to 4 players that runs in your browser on a phone or computer, with nothing to install. Characters race around the board collecting coins and buying stars. Every turn ends with a minigame, from Bumper Balls and Cake Dash to Memory Match and Pipe Puzzle, and the winner takes coins. Computer players fill any empty seats. At the end, bonus stars are handed out and the player with the most stars wins.
howItWasMade: Built with AI coding agents: builder agents write each piece, and critic agents judge it against a Mario Party 7 quality bar and name the biggest gap. Its art, animation and sound are generated in code by default, with exported 3D models where needed.

name: Flag Catch
description: 3D capture the flag with animal teams
longDescription: Flag Catch is a free 3D capture the flag game that runs right in your browser. Pick an animal, sneak into enemy land, grab a flag and race it home. Built with AI, with nothing to install.
about: Flag Catch is a free capture the flag game for phones and computers, with nothing to install. You pick an animal (a lion on a quad bike, a mammoth on a skateboard, a narwhal, a bat and more) and join a team of 8 to 64 against a rival team on an island split into three lands. Sneak into enemy land, grab a flag and carry it home while firecrackers, power ups and defenders try to stop you. Medics plant respawn flags, Hoard mode plays to a points target, and Playful mode is one flag a side. Eight worlds, from Home Isle to a lava island, open up as you earn points. Play with your phone held sideways, or switch on DS mode to hold it upright with the game on a top screen and the map and buttons on a bottom one.
howItWasMade: Built with AI coding agents in phases, from the core rules to worlds, animals, menus and sound. Every model, animation, sound and song is generated in code with three.js and Web Audio, with no art files.

name: Aurora's World
description: Squish, dress up and play with cute bao squishies
longDescription: Aurora's World is a free squishy toy game for kids that runs right in your browser. Squish, pet and hug soft bao squishies, play with them at the beach, on a sailing boat, in the living room or in a little city, raise baby squishies and dress them all in hats. Built with AI, with nothing to install.
about: Aurora's World is a free game for kids aged 4 and up, made for phones held upright, with nothing to install. Your squishy squashes right where your fingers press, and some are firm and springy while others are super soft and slow to rise. Open your first squishy from its steamer box, then learn to squish, pet, tickle, toss and hug it. Every squishy has its own personality, from bouncy and silly to sleepy, shy, musical or a little grumpy, and it shows in how they move, nap and play. Up to four squishies come out at once: while you hold one, the others play together behind it, do little jobs and come up to be loved. The places feel alive, with squishies swimming past at the beach and boat and walking the city street. Now and then you'll find a baby squishy fast asleep. Keep it with a cookie, play with it and teach it, and a week later it grows up with the personality you gave it. Play at the tea table, on a sunny beach, on a sailing boat, in a cozy living room or in Little City, and earn 21 hats that wobble as your squishies bounce. There are 66 squishies to find, 30 Bao Buns and 36 Spooky ones, in matte, shiny, glitter, glow and gold. No ads, no chat and no accounts; everything stays on your device.
howItWasMade: Built with AI coding agents one phase at a time. The soft squishy bodies, faces, personalities, hats, the five places, sounds and Squishy Island are all generated in code with three.js and Web Audio, with no art files.
